title: Sales & Solutions Engineer
description:
Fiat Chrysler-STELLANTIS México ((Abarth, Alfa Romeo, Fiat, Lancia, Maserati, Jeep, Chrysler, Dodge y RAM, Peugeot, Citroën, DS, Opel y Vauxhall), empresa trasnacional del sector automotriz y de las 25 mejores empresas para trabajar en México, te invita a formar parte de su equipo como: Sales & Solutions Engineer
Mobilisights : Enabling a Smarter World:
Exponential growth in adoption and deployment of connected cars and devices is bringing previously unavailable datasets to market – at scale and in real-time. Our vision is a ‘smarter’ world where innovative applications and services leverage connected vehicle datasets, and the insights they provide, to dramatically transform and continually improve everyday lives for consumers and businesses. Stellantis, one of the largest global car makers and the parent company of dozens of iconic brands including Jeep, Fiat, Maserati, Peugeots, and more, has created Mobilisights, a Data Business Unit to harness sensor and other data from 10s of millions of connected vehicles as well as that from IoT/connected devices from external sources to build data products and services that can power hundreds of brand-new B2B and B2C applications, services, and decision-making across industries.
Your Mission
We are on a mission to be a leading global provider of the highest quality data products, services, and rich, actionable insights derived from connected car data in a privacy-compliant, non-discriminatory, and easy-to-consume fashion.
 As a Sales & Solutions Engineer in our rapidly growing Sales team in North America, you will collaborate closely with the sales, engineering, and product teams to identify new opportunities to drive revenue growth and deliver top-notch technical and strategic assistance for highly intricate and advanced deals.
Responsibilities
Priorities can change in a high-growth startup environment like ours, so this role includes, but is not limited to the following responsibilities:
You will be a technical matter expert in Mobilisights data products, helping prospects and partners by explaining technical features and be their problem-solving interface, removing any potential roadblocks to close a dealAct as a liaison between product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and remaining highly available to sales and other cross-functional teamsOversee smooth integration and onboarding of new customers on Mobilisights’ data platform and work with product and technical teams to complete proof-of-concept and/or co-development efforts to help establish reference accounts in new market segmentsEnable deeper engagement into customer accounts (integration, upsell, cross sell) by becoming a trusted advisor to current and prospective customersDemonstrate the value proposition of Mobilisights’ products and services and the platform's core capabilities via webinar sessions, at customer sites or field events such as conferences and trade shows
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree5 years of experience in pre/post-sales engineering, customer success, professional services or a similar customer-facing role including 3 plus years of direct experience with technology/data products and platformsExperience developing technical GTM motions and strategies. Strong customer-centricity and problem-solving attitude to rapidly address customer issuesA blend of consultative selling skills and technical acumen to engage with product and engineering teams internally and in customer and partner accountsStrong analytical skills, with the ability to analyze customer data and develop actionable insightsFirst-hand experience working closely with early adopter customers to build solutions that scale for an entire market segmentProcess and data/analytics orientation with experience establishing processes: strong commitment to using tools and technology in managing sales process and tracking/reporting metrics Preferred Qualifications: 
Familiarity with common/popular tech stacks/architecture, cloud platforms, tools and applicationsConsistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cyclesAbility to explain and present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiencesEntrepreneurial spirit, and readiness to take on challenges with building and scaling a new businessExperience with use-cases in data-centric verticals such as insurance, mobility, telematics, and fleets Experience with data from connected cars and devices Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related field

title: Program Manager for Supplier Quality Product Development
description:
Job DescriptionThe Program Manager for Supplier Quality Product Development manages new, mid-cycle and carryover vehicle programs that are manufactured in North America(N.A.) and at an STELLANTIS affiliate facility located outside of the N.A. region. This position is responsible for ensuring key quality milestones/goals are met for all supplier components involved. The Program Manager will manage all aspects of the Advanced Supplier Quality functions as it pertains to STELLANTIS affiliate vehicle projects. This individual will work cross functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Purchasing through the full life cycle of components. This includes, but is not limited to early source package approvals, supplier eligibility, supplier selection, launch phase and into production.At all times, the Program Manager is considered the primary SQ contact for N.A. STELLANTIS plants, STELLANTIS affiliate plants in other regions and also the vehicle team for any concerns regarding the quality of parts that we receive from our suppliers.
